what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Zambia, as recorded by IDMC.
At the end of 2024, IDMC counted 186 people displaced by conflict and violence.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict for Zambia, so it does not say why people were displaced by violence.
IDMC's disaster records for Zambia list floods.

when.text: In 2024, IDMC recorded 513 new displacements by conflict and violence.
These count movements, not people; the main years of displacement in the data are 2024.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 3047 new displacements by disasters, also counting movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Zambia.
